[2] Basic analysis and visualization

[2.1] Functions to calculate the following metrics

– modified from those in the chytrid analysis

  • infestation_ratio, the ratio of the trees with herbivory)
  • average adult number (ave_basic), the total number of adults divided by the whole tree number
  • average herbivory impact (average_impact), the total number of adults divided by the number of trees with herbivory
  • deviation from Poisson distribution
  • standardized morisita index
#########mod function copied from  2022/04/06: preparation for kibanA2023##############
chytrid_distr_simple_v3 <- function(data, x_max = 10, LOG = F, title = "Diatom", graph = F, basic = F) {
  #delete long tail with NA
  data <- subset(data, complete.cases(data))
  
  #infections
  infections <- 0:(length(data) - 1)
  #observed
  observed <- c(data)
  total <- sum(observed)
  
  #See the estimation of lamda http://www.singularpoint.org/blog/math/stat/cramer-rao-2/
  lambda <- sum(infections * observed) / total
  
  expected <- total * ((lambda^infections) * exp(-lambda)) / factorial(infections)
  chi.squared <- (observed - expected)^2 / expected
  
  goodness.of.fit <- cbind(infections, observed, expected)
  colnames(goodness.of.fit) <- c('Infections', 'Observed Counts', 'Expected Counts')
  
  if(graph == T) {
    xmax <- x_max
    if(LOG == T) {
      plot(infections, log10(observed), xlim = c(0,xmax), ylim = c(-0,3), cex = 3, pch = 16, cex.axis = 2, main = title)
      lines(infections, log10(expected), col = 1, cex = 2, lwd = 3, lty = 2)
    }
    else {
      plot(infections, observed, xlim = c(0,xmax),cex=3, ylim=c(0,max(observed+10)), main=title)
      lines(infections, expected, col = 1, cex = 2, lwd=3,lty=2)
    }  
  }
  
  chi.squared.statistic = sum(chi.squared)
  
  #P Value for the Poisson distribution
  P_chisq_Poission <- pchisq(chi.squared.statistic, length(observed)-2, lower.tail = F)
  
  #For preparation for Morisita index calculation
  data3 <- c(0, 0, 0)  #dummy data
  
  j <- 1
  k <- 0
  m <- 1
  while(m <= total & j <= length(observed)) {
    if(observed[j] == 0) j <- j + 1
    else if (m > k && m <= k + observed[j]) {
      data3[m] <- j - 1
      m <- m + 1
    }
    else if (m == k + observed[j] + 1) {
      k <- k + observed[j]
      j <- j + 1
    }
  }
  
  ##Morisita index from library(vegan)
  data4 <- t(t(data3))
  morisita <- dispindmorisita(data4, unique.rm = FALSE, crit = 0.05)
  #imst is the standardized Morisita index: (-0.5:0.5) are confidence interval for random distribution
  
  #infection rate
  infection_rate <- 1.0 - observed[1] / total
  if(basic == T) {
    cat("The counted number of cells is:", total, "\n")
    cat("The counted number of infections is:", sum(infections*observed), "\n")
    cat("The infection rate is:", infection_rate, "\n")
    cat("The averaged number of infection per cell is:", lambda, "\n")
    cat("The probability with which Poisson distribution generates more extreme deviation:", P_chisq_Poission, "\n")
    cat("The standardized morisita index value is :", morisita$imst, "\n")
  
  }
    #cat("The data looks like\n")
  return(morisita$imst)
}

#########mod function copied from  2022/04/06: preparation for kibanA2023##############
chytrid_distr_simple_v4 <- function(data, x_max = 10, LOG = F, title = "Diatom", graph = F, basic = F) {
  #delete long tail with NA
  data <- subset(data, complete.cases(data))
  
  #infections
  infections <- 0:(length(data) - 1)
  #observed
  observed <- c(data)
  total <- sum(observed)
  
  #See the estimation of lamda http://www.singularpoint.org/blog/math/stat/cramer-rao-2/
  lambda <- sum(infections * observed) / total
  
  expected <- total * ((lambda^infections) * exp(-lambda)) / factorial(infections)
  chi.squared <- (observed - expected)^2 / expected
  
  goodness.of.fit <- cbind(infections, observed, expected)
  colnames(goodness.of.fit) <- c('Infections', 'Observed Counts', 'Expected Counts')
  
  if(graph == T) {
    xmax <- x_max
    if(LOG == T) {
      df_plot <- data.frame(
      infections = infections,
      observed   = observed,
      expected   = expected
      )

      p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = infections)) + 
        geom_point(
        aes(y = observed),
        shape = 16,
        size = 5.0
      ) +
      geom_line(
        aes(y = expected),
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = 1.0
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        limits = c(0, x_max),
        breaks = seq(0, x_max, 2)
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        trans = "log1p",
        breaks = c(0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 150, 200, 500)
      ) +
      labs(
        x = "Infection Intensity (# infections)",
        y = "Cell Abundance (Frequency)"
      ) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio = 1.0
      )
      print(p)
    }
    
    else {
      plot(infections, observed, xlim = c(0,xmax), cex = 3, ylim = c(0, max(observed + 10)), main=title)
      lines(infections, expected, col = 1, cex = 2, lwd = 3,lty = 2)
    }  
  }
  
  chi.squared.statistic = sum(chi.squared)
  
  #P Value for the Poisson distribution
  P_chisq_Poission <- pchisq(chi.squared.statistic, length(observed)-2, lower.tail = F)
  
  #For preparation for Morisita index calculation
  data3 <- c(0, 0, 0)  #dummy data
  
  j <- 1
  k <- 0
  m <- 1
  while(m <= total & j <= length(observed)) {
    if(observed[j] == 0) j <- j + 1
    else if (m > k && m <= k + observed[j]) {
      data3[m] <- j - 1
      m <- m + 1
    }
    else if (m == k + observed[j] + 1) {
      k <- k + observed[j]
      j <- j + 1
    }
  }
  
  ##Morisita index from library(vegan)
  data4 <- t(t(data3))
  morisita <- dispindmorisita(data4, unique.rm = FALSE, crit = 0.05)
  #imst is the standardized Morisita index: (-0.5:0.5) are confidence interval for random distribution
  
  #infection rate
  infection_rate <- 1.0 - observed[1] / total
  if(basic == T) {
    cat("The counted number of cells is:", total, "\n")
    cat("The counted number of infections is:", sum(infections*observed), "\n")
    cat("The infection rate is:", infection_rate, "\n")
    cat("The averaged number of infection per cell is:", lambda, "\n")
    cat("The probability with which Poisson distribution generates more extreme deviation:", P_chisq_Poission, "\n")
    cat("The morisita index value is :", morisita$imor, "\n")
    cat("The standardized morisita index value is :", morisita$imst, "\n")
  
  }
    #cat("The data looks like\n")
  return(morisita$imor)
}

– specific growth rate

specific_growth <- function(value_vec, time_vec, tau = 1) {
  vec_length <- length(value_vec)
  growth <- numeric(vec_length)
  
  for(j in 1:vec_length) {
    if(j + tau - 1 < 1 || j + tau > vec_length) growth[j] <- NA
    else {
      growth[j] <- log(value_vec[j + tau] / value_vec[j + tau - 1]) / (time_vec[j + tau] - time_vec[j + tau - 1])
      if(value_vec[j + tau] == 0 & value_vec[j + tau - 1] == 0) growth[j] <- 0 #exception
    }
    if(is.infinite(growth[j])) growth[j] <- NA
  }
  # Noting that the value is not calculated at the final time point
  return(growth)
}

sporangia <- 0
for(i in infection_range) sporangia <- sporangia + i * chytrid_raw_data[, 8 + i]
chytrid_summary_temp <- data.frame(
  day = chytrid_raw_data$day,
  treatment = chytrid_raw_data$treatment,
  bottle_ID = chytrid_raw_data$bottle_ID,
  diatom = apply(chytrid_raw_data[, 8 + infection_range], 1, sum),
  infection_ratio = 1 - chytrid_raw_data[, 8] / apply(chytrid_raw_data[, 8 + infection_range], 1, sum),
  chytrid_sporangia = sporangia
)
print(chytrid_summary_temp)

[2.3] Calculating morisita index and rates

#morisita
std_mi <- list()
raw_mi <- list()
for(i in 1:length(chytrid_raw_data[, 1])) {
  std_mi[[i]] <- chytrid_distr_simple_v3(unlist(chytrid_raw_data[i, 8 + infection_range]))
  raw_mi[[i]] <- chytrid_distr_simple_v4(unlist(chytrid_raw_data[i, 8 + infection_range]))
}

chytrid_summary_temp$raw_mi <- unlist(raw_mi)

)

– Decided not to include the standardized morisita, because it substantially depends on the number of quadrats (in our system, corresponding to the host cell abundance)

## =========================================================
## 2) DEFINE CANDIDATE MODELS (all subsets)
## =========================================================
# Model list as formulas; includes intercept-only baseline
candidate_formulas$popl_growth_1 <- list(
  m0 = as.formula("popl_growth_1 ~ 1"),

## =========================================================
## 3) LORO CORE: fit on 3 reps, predict on held-out rep among total 4 reps
##    Return per-rep metrics AND micro components (SSE/SAE/n)
## =========================================================
rmse <- function(e) sqrt(mean(e^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae  <- function(e) mean(abs(e), na.rm = TRUE)

fit_predict_loro_one <- function(df,
                                 test_rep,
                                 form,
                                 time_col,
                                 rep_col,
                                 response_col,
                                 min_test_n = 3) {

  # train / test split
  train <- df[df[[rep_col]] != test_rep, , drop = FALSE]
  test  <- df[df[[rep_col]] == test_rep, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(test) < min_test_n) return(NULL)

  # Fit (ML for model comparison)
  fit <- try(
    gls(form,
        data = train,
        correlation = corCAR1(form = as.formula(paste0("~", time_col, "|", rep_col))),
        method = "ML",
        na.action = na.omit),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  #if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    message("gls failed for rep=", test_rep, "\n", fit)
    return(NULL)
  }
  # Prediction
  pred <- try(predict(fit, newdata = test), silent = TRUE)
  #if (inherits(pred, "try-error")) return(NULL)
  if (inherits(pred, "try-error")) {
    message("predict failed for rep=", test_rep, "\n", pred)
    message("train treatment table:\n"); print(table(train$treatment, useNA = "ifany"))
    message("test  treatment table:\n"); print(table(test$treatment,  useNA = "ifany"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  # Prediction error
  err <- test[[response_col]] - pred

  data.frame(
    rep    = as.character(test_rep),
    n_test = length(err),
    RMSE   = sqrt(mean(err^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MAE    = mean(abs(err), na.rm = TRUE),
    SSE    = sum(err^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    SAE    = sum(abs(err), na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

loro_eval_model <- function(df,
                            form,
                            time_col,
                            rep_col,
                            response_col,
                            min_test_n = 3) {

  reps <- unique(df[[rep_col]])

  out <- do.call(rbind, lapply(reps, function(rp) {
    fit_predict_loro_one(df           = df,
                         test_rep     = rp,
                         form         = form,
                         time_col     = time_col,
                         rep_col      = rep_col,
                         response_col = response_col,
                         min_test_n   = min_test_n)
  }))

  out
}

## =========================================================
fit_predict_loro_one_v2 <- function(df,
                                 test_rep,
                                 form,
                                 time_col,
                                 rep_col,
                                 response_col,
                                 min_test_n = 3) {

  # train / test split
  train <- df[df[[rep_col]] != test_rep, , drop = FALSE]
  test  <- df[df[[rep_col]] == test_rep, , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(test) < min_test_n) return(NULL)

  # Fit (ML for model comparison)
  fit <- try(
    gls(form,
        data = train,
        correlation = corCAR1(form = as.formula(paste0("~", time_col, "|", rep_col))),
        method = "ML",
        na.action = na.omit),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) return(NULL)

  # Prediction
  pred <- try(predict(fit, newdata = test), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(pred, "try-error")) return(NULL)

  return(pred)
}

## =========================================================
## 5) AGGREGATE: macro (rep-average) + micro (all points)
## =========================================================
macro_micro_summary <- function(dat) {
  # Macro: average across reps (each rep gets equal weight)
  macro_rmse <- mean(dat$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE)
  macro_mae  <- mean(dat$MAE,  na.rm = TRUE)

  # Micro: pool all test points (weighted by n_test)
  micro_rmse <- sqrt(sum(dat$SSE, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(dat$n_test, na.rm = TRUE))
  micro_mae  <- sum(dat$SAE, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(dat$n_test, na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    n_rep_used = nrow(dat),
    macro_RMSE = macro_rmse,
    micro_RMSE = micro_rmse,
    macro_MAE  = macro_mae,
    micro_MAE  = micro_mae,
    macro_RMSE_sd = sd(dat$RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

make_score_table <- function(results) {

  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(results), function(nm) {

    dat <- results[[nm]]

    # when no results available
    if (is.null(dat) || nrow(dat) == 0) {
      return(data.frame(
        model = nm,
        n_rep_used = 0,
        macro_RMSE = NA,
        micro_RMSE = NA,
        macro_MAE  = NA,
        micro_MAE  = NA,
        macro_RMSE_sd = NA,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }

    # usual cases
    cbind(
      model = nm,
      macro_micro_summary(dat),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
}

 chytrid_summary2_for_compare$popl_pred_base[j] <- chytrid_summary2_for_compare[j - 1, "sporangia"] * exp(popl_growth_pred_base[j - 1] * delta_t)
  
  
}

## =========================================================
## 2) DEFINE CANDIDATE MODELS (all subsets)
## =========================================================
# Model list as formulas; includes intercept-only baseline
candidate_formulas$prev_growth_1 <- list(
  m0 = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ 1"),
  m_host = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ diatom"),
  m_pop = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ sporangia"),
  m_prev = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ infection_ratio"),
  m_mi = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ raw_mi"),
  m_host_pop = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ diatom + sporangia"),
  m_host_prev = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ diatom + infection_ratio"),
  m_pop_prev = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ sporangia + infection_ratio"),
  m_host_mi = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ diatom + raw_mi"),
  m_pop_mi = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ sporangia + raw_mi"),
  m_prev_mi = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ infection_ratio + raw_mi"),
  m_host_pop_prev = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ diatom + sporangia + infection_ratio"),
  m_host_prev_mi = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ infection_ratio + raw_mi"),
  m_pop_prev_mi = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ sporangia + infection_ratio + raw_mi"),
  m_host_pop_mi = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ diatom + sporangia + raw_mi"),
  m_all = as.formula("prev_growth_1 ~ diatom + sporangia + infection_ratio + raw_mi")
)

#cor_struct <- corAR1(form =  dayN | treatment_bottle)
## =========================================================
## 4) RUN LORO FOR ALL MODELS: with min_test_n = 4, one rep excluded, fit on 3 reps, predict on held-out rep among total 4 reps 
## =========================================================
results_LORO$prev_growth_1 <- lapply(candidate_formulas$prev_growth_1, function(fm) {
  loro_eval_model(df           = chytrid_summary_ar,
                  form         = fm,
                  time_col     = "dayN",
                  rep_col      = "treatment_bottle",   # select replication info
                  response_col = "prev_growth_1",     # select response variable
                  min_test_n   = 3)
})
score_table$prev_growth_1 <- make_score_table(results_LORO$prev_growth_1)

# Rank (choose criterion; micro _RMSE is used 
score_table$prev_growth_1 <- score_table$prev_growth_1[order(score_table$prev_growth_1$micro_RMSE), ]
print(score_table$prev_growth_1)
best_model_name$prev_growth_1 <- score_table$prev_growth_1$model[which.min(score_table$prev_growth_1$micro_RMSE)]
best_formula$prev_growth_1 <- candidate_formulas$prev_growth_1[[best_model_name$prev_growth_1]]
cat("\nBest by micro_RMSE:", best_model_name$prev_growth_1, "\n", deparse(best_formula$prev_growth_1), "\n")

Best by micro_RMSE: m_mi 
 prev_growth_1 ~ raw_mi 
## =========================================================
## 6) FINAL REFIT: refit the selected structure on ALL data by REML
##    and report coefficients + CI
## =========================================================
final_fit$prev_growth_1 <- gls(best_formula$prev_growth_1,
                 data = chytrid_summary_ar,
                 correlation = corCAR1(form = ~ dayN | treatment_bottle),
                 method = "REML",
                 na.action = na.omit)

cat("\nFinal model (REML) summary:\n")

Visualization 02
b <- results_LORO$prev_growth_1$m_prev[, c("rep","n_test","RMSE")]
best <- results_LORO$prev_growth_1$m_mi[, c("rep","n_test","RMSE")]
alt  <- results_LORO$prev_growth_1$m_host_mi[, c("rep","n_test","RMSE")]

names(b)[names(b)=="RMSE"] <- "RMSE_macro_only"
names(best)[names(best)=="RMSE"] <- "RMSE_best"
names(alt)[names(alt)=="RMSE"] <- "RMSE_host_mi"

# merge the data
w <- merge(b, best[, c("rep","RMSE_best")], by = "rep", all = FALSE)
w <- merge(w, alt[,  c("rep","RMSE_host_mi")],  by = "rep", all = FALSE)

w$delta_best  <- w$RMSE_macro_only - w$RMSE_best
w$delta_host_mi  <- w$RMSE_macro_only - w$RMSE_host_mi

# converting long format
df_delta <- rbind(
  data.frame(rep = w$rep, n_test = w$n_test, delta_RMSE = w$delta_best,  model = "Best"),
  data.frame(rep = w$rep, n_test = w$n_test, delta_RMSE = w$delta_host_mi,  model = "host_mi")
)

# if ordering based on the improvement by the best model
#df_delta$rep <- factor(df_delta$rep, levels = w$rep[order(w$delta_best, decreasing = TRUE)])
ggplot(df_delta, aes(x = rep, y = delta_RMSE, group = model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_test, color = model), alpha = 0.85, position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Best" = "#1b9e77",
                                "host_mi" = "#d95f02"),
                     name = "Model") +
  labs(x = "rep", y = expression(Delta*RMSE == RMSE[macro_only] - RMSE[model]),
       size = "n_test",
       title = "Chytrid prev:Per-replicate improvement") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
    aspect.ratio = 0.65
        )

prev_growth_pred_best <- fit_predict_loro_one_v2(df = chytrid_summary_ar,
                        test_rep = "control_WC1",
                        form = candidate_formulas$prev_growth_1$m_mi,
                        time_col = "dayN",

                        response_col = "prev_growth_1",
                        min_test_n = 3
)

                        test_rep = "control_WC1",

                        min_test_n = 3
)

                        test_rep = "control_WC1",
                        form = candidate_formulas$prev_growth_1$m_prev,
                        time_col = "dayN",
                        rep_col = "treatment_bottle",   
                        response_col = "prev_growth_1",
                        min_test_n = 3
)
#starting point, identical to observation
chytrid_summary2_for_compare$prev_pred_best[1] <- chytrid_summary2_for_compare$infection_ratio[1]
  
chytrid_summary2_for_compare$prev_pred_alt_micro[1] <- chytrid_summary2_for_compare$infection_ratio[1]

chytrid_summary2_for_compare$prev_pred_base[1] <- chytrid_summary2_for_compare$infection_ratio[1]

 
for(j in 2:9) {
  # time period
  delta_t <- chytrid_summary2_for_compare[j, "dayN"] - chytrid_summary2_for_compare[j - 1, "dayN"]
  
 chytrid_summary2_for_compare$prev_pred_best[j] <- chytrid_summary2_for_compare[j - 1, "infection_ratio"] * exp(prev_growth_pred_best[j - 1] * delta_t)
 
 chytrid_summary2_for_compare$prev_pred_alt_micro[j] <- chytrid_summary2_for_compare[j - 1, "infection_ratio"] * exp(prev_growth_pred_alt_micro[j - 1] * delta_t)
 
 chytrid_summary2_for_compare$prev_pred_base[j] <- chytrid_summary2_for_compare[j - 1, "infection_ratio"] * exp(prev_growth_pred_base[j - 1] * delta_t)
  
  
}
